svg.title: GitHub contribution snake
svg.desc: A cyan and teal snake travels through the real GitHub contribution calendar from 2026-07-12 to 2026-10-31. The calendar contains 112 days and 693 contributions. Squares are consumed for the animation and restored each loop. Source as of 2026-10-31T02:49:51.248000+00:00. Reduced-motion mode shows the complete static calendar.

g.text: A little play, built from real contribution history.
